candidates: When visualizing atomic structures in Sphinx Gallery tutorial files (e.g., under `examples/tutorials/`), use `plot_atoms()` from `ase.visualize.plot` rather than bare `matplotlib` methods, as it renders correctly in the compiled gallery output.

When porting a legacy RST tutorial to Sphinx Gallery, verify that all structural visualizations present in the original (e.g., initial-state, final-state, and transition-state figures) are reproduced or replaced with equivalent `plot_atoms()` figures in the new tutorial file — do not silently drop them.

When showing GPAW parallel-run invocations in tutorials or documentation, use the form `gpaw -P<N> python <script>.py` rather than `mpiexec -np <N> gpaw-python <script>.py`, as the former is the currently recommended way to launch GPAW parallel jobs.
